notes.title: SPACEUM: The Ultimate Space Horror – Final Version on Steam!
notes.notes:
🚀 SPACEUM is out! Are you ready to escape? (with SUPER-Optimization) 🚀

The space station is infected! Deadly parasites have infiltrated, and your only chance to get out is to activate the access code for the shuttle. But it won’t be that easy...

🔹 Find and activate the levers in the correct sequence. 🔹 Enter the code through the console. 🔹 Or take a risk—hunt the alien and get the backup transmitter!

Two ways to play, an atmospheric horror experience, realistic graphics, and randomized scenarios. Every run brings new challenges, new aliens, and new puzzles!

💀 Can you survive? Test yourself in the final version of SPACEUM on Steam! 💀
